mutants.name: extreme_options_only
mutants.desc: DP where each section only considers x in {0, D//L1, ceil(D/L1)} type-1 sensors (fill-max then remainder)

mutants.name: floor_y
mutants.desc: DP with remaining-length type-2 count computed by floor division instead of ceiling

mutants.name: greedy_cheaper_per_meter
mutants.desc: greedy: fill every section with the cheaper-per-meter sensor first, overflow to the other type

mutants.name: independent_cheapest
mutants.desc: picks each section's cheapest (x, y) independently, then returns -1 if global limits are exceeded

mutants.name: x_floor_bound
mutants.desc: DP where per-section type-1 count only ranges up to D // L1 (misses covering with type-1 alone)
